prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original production FAR DISTANCE LANDSCAPE layer for Last Star, a painterly moonlit celestial-gothic side-scrolling fantasy game. Reference image is the current horizon: retain its wide 3:1 silhouette logic and blue mountain identity, but create a richer new version, not a collage. Render a single very wide 3:1 image. Transparent empty sky above an uninterrupted opaque mountain silhouette; all mountain/stone/building interiors fully opaque and the entire bottom edge filled with solid terrain. NO sky color, no cloud bank, no moon, no foreground, no characters, no text.
Composition: sculpted distant indigo mountains on the left, broad quiet valley in center, and ONE extraordinary ancient astronomical observatory rising on supported stone mountain terraces in the right third. Observatory should have a readable central ribbed dome, slender gothic bell spire, one immense circular astrolabe window of pale muted turquoise stained glass, and two smaller asymmetrical towers joined with believable supported bridges. Ornament large and intentional; no marching repeated arches. Clear vertical stone columns, attached dome supports, no buildings fused into rocks. Topmost tower must fit with at least 12% transparent padding above. Buildings begin near x 65% and peak around x 78%. 
Art direction: restrained cinematic hand-painted fantasy with broad, elegant silhouettes, blue slate rock planes and atmospheric distance PAINTED INTO OPAQUE COLOR. Low-to-medium contrast distant terrain; no blazing white snow or crunchy high-frequency foliage. Silver-blue rim highlights on selected mountain summits. Observatory almost silhouette-dark midnight teal, with warm antique-gold pinpoints in a FEW windows and soft low-intensity blue-green rose-window glow; no neon. Distant lower pine ridges form quiet graphic bands. Rich architectural beauty and subtle carved detail visible when enlarged, simplified enough behind gameplay. One focal landmark only.
Transparency: genuine alpha for empty sky and open architectural holes; keep sky transparent and solid land truly opaque. No fake checkerboard, black background, cast shadows, frames or labels. Entire width ends as continuous mountain terrain at both side edges, lower terrain fills canvas to bottom.
notes: Original versioned art; independent transparent sky. Landmark is one supported astronomical observatory, not a new playable structure.
